title: Ritedose Announces Manufacturing for Tenpoint Therapeutics’ Presbyopia Eye Drop
llm_note: Ritedose has been contracted to manufacture YUVEZZI, an FDA-approved eye drop, for Tenpoint Therapeutics.

title: Shionogi nabs initial $119M award from BARDA to establish US antibiotic plant
llm_note: Shionogi received $119 million from BARDA to establish a new U.S. antibiotic manufacturing plant.

title: Akari locks arms with WuXi XDC to develop and manufacture novel ADC treatment
llm_note: Akari Therapeutics partnered with WuXi XDC for the development and manufacturing of an ADC treatment.

title: With Gardasil demand shortfall in China, Merck and Zhifei adjust their partnership
llm_note: Merck is adjusting its manufacturing and supply partnership with Zhifei due to Gardasil demand shortfalls in China.

title: With Sanofi and Pfizer deals, Novavax bets on ‘amplification strategy’ to drive vaccines engine
llm_note: Novavax is licensing its Matrix-M vaccine adjuvant technology to Sanofi and Pfizer for their vaccine production.

title: Merck adjusts its vaccine supply deal in China; Soleno withdraws EU application
llm_note: Merck and Zhifei adjusted their vaccine supply agreement due to shifting demand.

title: STAT+: Trump announces 100% tariffs on brand-name drugs, with plenty of carveouts
llm_note: New tariffs offer reduced rates for companies that commit to bringing drug production to the U.S.
